notes: Suno v5.5 instrument kit DNA per color identity. Style prompts are comma-separated tags for the Style of Music field (max 1000 chars). Structure templates use Suno metatags for the Lyrics field.

kits.style_prompt: industrial techno, minimal techno, 130 BPM, dry punchy mechanical drums, sub bass, cold sparse atmosphere, raw, warehouse, dark, aggressive, no melody, instrumental
kits.structure_template:
[Instrumental Intro: cold, mechanical, 4 bars]
[Instrumental: dry kick + sub pressure, industrial percussion loop]
[Build: tension rising, minimal layers]
[Instrumental: peak pressure, relentless, flat energy]
[Instrumental Break: stripped to kick + sub]
[Instrumental: industrial textures return, controlled aggression]
[Outro: fade to silence]
